summary: Mobile QA for Phase 39M.5 — warm theme re-skin + 4 features (Now Playing stop, Recent/Favorites, Country filter, Skip onboarding). 4 of 5 features PASS, 1 FAIL. THEME re-skin verified across Home, Radio, Wallet, Games, More/Profile, Stations, Now Playing, Passport, Play & Win, Trivia — warm cream bg (#FBF5EC), coral-orange primary (#F26B2A), blue secondary, golden BigCoin, warm near-black text; no white-on-white regressions detected; tab bar uses outline Ionicons with orange active tint. NOW PLAYING flow works end-to-end via MiniPlayer tap — title 'Talk 100.3 UAE', artist 'United Arab Emirates · english hindi', LIVE pill, play/pause toggle works (icon flips), red 'Stop' button releases the player, clears MiniPlayer, and navigates back. RECENT/FAVORITES persisted store works — heart on a Browse row favorites the station (heart fills, Favorites tab shows 1 entry with header count), playing a station records it under Recent (verified 'Talk 100.3 UAE' appears in Recent with header '1 recently played'). SKIP ONBOARDING works — onboarding-skip-btn renders on step 1, tapping it routes to /(tabs)/radio (URL after skip = /radio). COUNTRY FILTER BROKEN: selecting any specific country (UAE/India/USA/UK/etc.) returns 0 stations because the shared backend GET /api/radio/browse?source=imported&country=<full name> returns total=0 for every value tried, even though the same endpoint w/o country returns stations whose 'country' field IS those exact strings (United Arab Emirates, United States, India). Verified via direct curl. Language chip + search still work correctly.

critical.issue: Country filter returns total=0 for every country the mobile UI sends (United Arab Emirates, India, United States, United Kingdom, Pakistan, Saudi Arabia, Germany) although the same endpoint w/o country returns stations whose country field is literally 'United Arab Emirates', 'United States', 'India'. So the imported-station filter is not matching against the country field. As a result the new COUNTRY FILTER on /stations always produces an empty list.

ui_bugs.issue: Selecting any country chip (stations-country-uae/india/usa/uk/pakistan/saudi/germany) always yields the empty state 'No stations found — Try a different search, country or language.' and the header sub loses its count and shows 'Browse live radio worldwide'. Root cause is backend, but UX-wise there is no client-side hint that the filter is unsupported.

integration_issues.issue: Chip -> /api/radio/browse?source=imported&country=<full name> -> total=0. Feature is unusable end-to-end until backend country-match for imported stations is fixed.

issues: Country chip row + Language chip row are stacked with only ~6px between them; on 390px viewport they sit right up against each other which looks like one visually crowded band. Consider a small vertical gap or a subtle divider/label ('COUNTRY'/'LANGUAGE') between the two horizontal filter strips.

react_native_issues.issue: Runtime console error: 'Unexpected text node: . A text node cannot be a child of a <View>.' — indicates a stray whitespace/string somewhere inside a View (likely a conditional render leaking a space). Non-fatal but should be tracked down.
Console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Carryover from iter 31; cosmetic on RN Web preview only.
Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents.' Carryover from iter 31; cosmetic on RN Web preview only.

Verified: curl /api/radio/browse?source=imported&country=United%20Arab%20Emirates -> total 0 while /api/radio/browse?source=imported -> total 2012 and first rows have country='United Arab Emirates'.

now_playing.title: Talk 100.3 UAE

action_items: HIGH: Fix backend /api/radio/browse country filter for source=imported. Country chips send full names ('United Arab Emirates', 'India', 'United States', 'United Kingdom', 'Pakistan', 'Saudi Arabia', 'Germany') but backend returns total=0 for each. Either add a case-insensitive contains/exact match on the country field of imported stations OR change the chip values on mobile to the token the backend actually indexes on (e.g. ISO code or 'UAE'/'US' short form). Currently the whole new country-filter feature is a no-op.
MEDIUM: Add a small vertical gap or divider between the country chip strip and the language chip strip on /stations Browse — they are visually flush right now.
LOW: Track down 'Unexpected text node' console error — likely a stray whitespace inside a <View> conditional render.
OPTIONAL (carryover): migrate shadow* style props to boxShadow and props.pointerEvents to style.pointerEvents to silence RN Web console warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: stations.tsx COUNTRIES table: values are full country names (e.g. 'United Arab Emirates'). If the backend indexes country_code / short code (e.g. 'AE', 'UAE') for imported stations the filter will never match. Confirm the imported-station schema field before choosing between fixing backend match or shortening the chip values.

now-playing.tsx: stop() cleanly releases the player, clears session/seg/channel and calls router.back(). If the user reaches /now-playing via URL directly there is no history to pop and RN Web warns 'GO_BACK not handled' — consider router.canGoBack ? back() : router.replace('/(tabs)/radio') as a defensive fallback.

useStationsStore: FAV_KEY/REC_KEY are hardcoded strings scoped per-device only (no user-id namespace). Two users sharing the same browser/profile would see each other's favorites & recents. Minor concern for a demo build but worth noting.

audioController.togglePlayback() returns true/false based on p.playing after the toggle — on some expo-audio versions the property lags the actual state until the next event; watch for a case where the Now Playing icon and the actual audio drift. Not observed in this run but structurally possible.

success_rate.backend: n/a (skipped per request; noted 1 endpoint bug via curl)
success_rate.frontend: 80% — 4/5 features pass; country filter fails end-to-end due to backend

context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 39M.5 verification: theme re-skin + Now Playing Stop + Favorites/Recent + Skip Onboarding all pass. The single blocker is the COUNTRY FILTER — mobile UI wiring is correct (chip -> full country name -> /api/radio/browse?source=imported&country=...) but the backend returns total=0 for every specific country. This needs a backend fix (or a change to the mobile chip values to match whatever the backend indexes on). After the fix, only re-run: /stations -> tap 'UAE' -> expect header count > 0 and first row a UAE flagship; then tap 'India' -> expect header count > 0. Everything else in this iteration passed and does not need re-testing.
rca of the issue: Backend /api/radio/browse endpoint accepts the ?country= query param and evidently applies it as an exact match against a column that is NOT set to the full country name for imported (radio-browser) stations, even though the response BODY for those same rows contains the full name in the country field. Likely the backend column for imported rows is either NULL, or a code/slug (e.g. 'AE'), or the filter is applied against a different collection than the one returned. Reproduction: (1) GET /api/radio/browse?source=imported returns 2012 rows with country='United Arab Emirates' etc. (2) GET /api/radio/browse?source=imported&country=United%20Arab%20Emirates returns total=0. Same for India / United States. Mitigation options: (a) fix backend filter to a case-insensitive contains match on the same country field returned in the response, or (b) expose a country_code/tag field on imported stations and switch the mobile COUNTRIES table values to the same tokens.
